checkpoint_rule: Use the final fixed update; no checkpoint or seed selection on quality trials
scope: Same reference data, architecture, inherited relative feedback, normalization, update budget and quality gate as the joint-input initializer. Zero and mask only the decoder input weights from the observation encoder during supervised fitting; actual observation still drives frozen relative balance feedback. Remove the fitting hook before saving so a later shared RL run may learn that path from identical initial outputs. This tests whether on-reference observation shortcuts hurt closed-loop initialization, not world-model/PPO efficiency or generalization.
